definitions.explanation: A casual clipped form of クラウドファンディング, referring to raising money for a project or cause by collecting small contributions from many people online. Common in everyday and social-media speech.

examples.japanese: クラファンで{資金|しきん}を{集|あつ}めた。
その{映画|えいが}はクラファンで{制作|せいさく}された。
examples.english: That film was produced with crowdfunding.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{商品|しょうひん}を{世|よ}に{出|だ}すために、クラファンを{立|た}ち{上|あ}げることにした。
examples.english: We decided to launch a crowdfunding campaign to bring the new product to market.

notes:
Casual abbreviation of クラウドファンディング (crowdfunding), formed by clipping and combining the first parts of each element. Common in conversation and online; the full form is preferred in formal writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- クラファンで{集|あつ}める: to raise (money) via crowdfunding
- クラファンを{立|た}ち{上|あ}げる: to launch a crowdfunding campaign
- クラファンに{参加|さんか}する: to back a crowdfunding project
